thread:
erin (PM): Heads up — large adtech customer asks for a pricing/packaging path: per-customer hard limits, priority lanes, and contract-level overage blocking. They want to include it in their enterprise contract. Need quick scope call.

pete (Eng): From infra side: fast path is route tagging + metering and UI for visibility. Hard blocking requires quota store + fast checks at gateway.

lina (Sales): Customer insists on hard blocks due to budget controls. Pilot can show soft alerts, but contract must promise hard enforcement at GA.

erin (PM): Proposed incremental plan: V1 = per-route tagging + billing visibility + soft alerts. V2 = hard cap enforcement + admin override + audit logs. V3 = SLA-backed priority lane.

omar (Legal): Contract concerns: define "hard block" semantics (refunds, emergencies), add dispute window, and codify admin override audit trail. I'll draft pilot and GA clauses.

zoe (Solutions): Console needs per-route toggle, estimated monthly spend, and a clear admin override flow with audit capture. Also sample onboarding docs for tagging.

pete (Eng): Estimates: V1 (tagging + UI) = 1 sprint. V2 (quota infra + gateway checks) = 3-4 sprints. V3 (priority lane isolation + SLA automation) = 6+ sprints.

erin (PM): Launch criteria for V1-beta: 1) Billing shows per-route cost in Console 2) Soft alerts firing and webhookable 3) Pilot signed with NDA. GA requires V2 + legal templates.

lina (Sales): I'll confirm NDA and ask customer to accept V1 pilot. They want to see soft alert webhook in demo.

omar (Legal): For pilot: "Beta features provided AS-IS; enforcement and SLA apply post-GA". For GA: define remedies and emergency override procedure.

infra-bot: pipeline:feature-flag "route-caps-v1" enabled in staging; integration tests queued.

erin (PM): Action items: Pete -> RFC + tickets for V1; Zoe -> Console mock + estimator; Omar -> contract drafts; Lina -> pilot NDA and demo scheduling. Sync Thurs 3pm.

lina (Sales): Customer asked if emergency override can be self-service; will push but legal will likely want signed acknowledgement.

erin (PM): Noted. We'll provide an admin flow for override but require audit sign-off and optionally a signed waiver for repeated overrides. Thanks team.
